{{Quote|Any pet worth having is to be had at ''Sabodor's'', best in the Sector.|Sabodor|<ref name="HSSE" />}}
'''Sabodor's''' was a petshop on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. Run by the [[Rakririan]] [[Sabodor]], it catered to the wealthy upper class of Etti, and was considered the best of the numerous petstores there.

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited Sabodor's to purchase a [[Dinko (creature)|dinko]]. At that time it also contained [[Spidery nightglider|spidery night-gliders]] of [[Altarrn]], feathered [[song serpent]]s from the deserts of [[Proxima Dibal]]'s single planet, and the tiny [[marsupial]]s from [[Kimanan]], commonly known as [[Furball (creature)|furballs]].

The store was equipped with an expensive muting system, but even that was not capable of masking all the scents and sounds from the stock.
